name: Exhaustion Drag
description: Pool budget sized to deliverable inventory (~$20/day at ~14 req/s through the dev port-forward) so aggregate pacing CAN reach 1.0. Small campaigns exhaust mid-day while the big one stays live — exercises whether exhausted campaigns' spend keeps inflating the site-level spendRatio and throttles the survivors (issue #8 F1). Watch BATCH PACING spendRatio between the smalls' exhaustion and the day rollover.
